contentHtml:
Identification in Qatar is essential for citizens and expats, so knowing the QID status is important. This document (Qatar ID) will allow you to carry out the necessary procedures and be in order with the regulations of the authorities. Moreover, the authorities implemented this document in 2011 for foreigners to simplify procedures and maintain proper registration.

In this article, we will show you how to check QID status through the means provided by the authorities. Likewise, you will be able to know all the details about Qatar ID. Let us see:

  1. What is Qatar ID or QID?
  2. How to perform the MOI Qatar ID validity check
  3. Renew your QID easily
  4. We can offer you more information about the QID status

1. What is Qatar ID or QID?

Before you know how you can check the QID status, you will be able to know what this ID is if you do not already know. The Qatar ID (Qatar ID or QID) is the card that all people who live and work in the country must possess. In this case, the authorities issue this document to citizens, residents, and foreign workers.

In addition, the QID serves as proof of identity and residence, which is also useful for carrying out various activities. Therefore, it is imperative to know how to check Qatar ID to know its validity and renew it on time. This is because, with that document, you will be able to, among other things, do the following:

  • Open a bank account.
  • Get a driver’s license in Qatar.
  • Have access to government services.
  • Sponsor your family.

ID check Qatar can be carried out by the authorities in different circumstances, so keep it handy at all times. Also, this document contains the following:

  • Photo of the holder.
  • Name.
  • QID number.
  • Birthdate.
  • Nationality.
  • Signature.
  • Holder sponsor information.

In addition, the QID number contains 11 digits with all the personal information of the holder, stored in the database of the authorities. In addition, it serves to know the identity of the person who owns it and their residence rights in Qatar.

1.1 Data contained in the QID number

Your ID card number is required to verify your QID status as it contains relevant data. Thus, this number contains data about your age and nationality so that the authorities can verify it immediately. The number contains the following information:

  • The first digit indicates the year of your birth; so if you were born before 1999 the number is 2 but if you were born after 2000 the number is 3.
  • The second and third digits indicate your year of birth.
  • Digits 4,5, and 6 indicate the ISO code of your country of origin.
  • The last 5 numbers indicate the number of Qataris who were born in the same year as you.

1.2 The Ministry of the Interior (MOI) issues the QID

The Ministry of the Interior of Qatar is the body in charge of issuing this identification through its website. Also, this is the same website where you will be able to do the Qatar ID online check. The application process is easy, you just have to follow the next steps:

  1. On the MOI portal go to Department Services.
  2. Then select Official Document Services.
  3. Finally, choose Qatar ID Card Application.

Once you have completed these steps, you will be able to do the QID tracking to see the status of your application.

1.3 Requirements to apply for Qatar ID?

To apply for your QID, you will need to submit some documents to get approved. The list of required documents is as follows:

  • Application form with all the data, you can find it on the website of the Ministry of the Interior.
  • Original and copy of passport.
  • Photocopy of your birth certificate.
  • Passport-size photos (for children under 12 and over 65).
  • Letter of consent from parents or guardians.
  • Photocopy of the QID of the parents.
  • Fingerprints.
  • Results of the medical examination (including X-rays and blood group).
  • The physical appearance of first-time applicants.

In addition, for expatriate workers, the process and payment to obtain the QID must be carried out by the employer.

1.4 Fees to obtain the QID

Residents can apply for the Smart ID through the Qatar Ministry of Interior website. In addition, the costs that must be covered are the following:

  • The common card and the smart card have the same cost, QR 100.
  • 1 year of e-gate service costs QR 100.
  • 2 years of e-gate services cost QR 150.
  • 3 years of e-gate services cost QR 200.

However, there are other costs that you will have to cover according to the duration and the type of electronic services selected.

2. How to perform the MOI Qatar ID validity check

It is possible to perform an ID check online through the official website of the Ministry of the Interior (MOI). The steps are very simple and you will be able to perform the validation check quickly as follows:

  1. Enter the MOI website.
  2. In the appropriate section enter your QID number or Qatar identification number.
  3. Next, you must complete the Captcha.
  4. Click Search.

In this way, you will be able to know the QID status, which includes the expiration date of your document. In the same way, you will know the expiration date of your passport and that of the residence visa. However, if you enter the wrong number and the page shows no result, just select Reset and enter the number again.

2.1 Qatar ID check by passport number

You can also do Qatar ID check online by passport number on the MOI website. Thus, you only have to follow the steps detailed below:

  1. Enter the Qatar ID status verification section on the MOI platform.
  2. Then write your passport number.
  3. Now select your nationality.
  4. Solve the Captcha.
  5. Finally, click Search.

As with the process of checking the QID status using the ID number, with this process you will get the same information.

3. Renew your QID easily

Another important process is the Qatar ID check renewal, as this document has a deadline. However, carriers have a grace period after their ID expires to renew it and avoid penalties. In this case, the grace period is 3 months, although you can renew the ID 3 months before it expires.

The fine in Qatar for the late renewal of the ID is QR 10 for each day that the document is not renewed. Therefore, it is essential to perform the QID status check so as not to skip this period and have to pay fines. In addition, the renewal process does not represent any complication since there are various methods available.

Thus, the authorities have both online and offline methods for those who wish to carry out the process in person. However, online methods only guarantee renewal for a period between 1 and 3 years.

3.1 Renew your QID through the MOI website

The renewal process is as simple as the QID check through the Ministry of the Interior platform. The steps you must follow are described below:

  1. Log in to the MOI portal using your smart card.
  2. Then select Residential Services.
  3. Next, select Renew Residency.
  4. Then you can opt for the following renewal:
    • Renewal for individuals. You can enter up to 5 QID numbers that you want to renew
    • Renovation for companies. You can enter up to 20 QID numbers that you want to renew
  1. Now, click Add.
  2. In the next step, you must select the period for which you wish to renew the QID(s).
  3. Now, you must choose the document delivery option.
  4. Pay the corresponding fees.

After completing the process, you can keep an eye on the QID renewal status at any time in online services.

3.2 Metrash2 Application for Qatar ID Renewal

It is also possible to renew and do the Qatar ID checking through the Metrash2 application, available for various devices. The process is as follows:

  1. After downloading the app, log in with your Metrash2 account.
  2. Select Residential Services.
  3. Now, you must choose Renew residence.
  4. At this stage, you must select whether the renewal is personal (up to 5 QID) or for companies (up to 20 QID).
  5. Click Add.
  6. Select the renewal period.
  7. Select the shipping method of the QID.
  8. Write the address to which your document will be sent.
  9. Next, pay the required fees for the service (by debit or credit card).

Also, you can check Qatar ID to keep an eye on your document renewal process.

3.3 ID renewal in person

If you wish to renew your QID in person, the authorities offer you the alternative of doing so at the Department of Nationality and Travel Documents. The process varies depending on whether the applicant is a citizen or expatriate as follows:

3.3.1 Citizens

The renewal process for Qatari citizens who want to complete it in person is as follows:

  1. Download and properly fill out the application form from the official website of the MOI.
  2. Go with the form to the Nationality and Travel Documents Department.
  3. Present your current ID.
  4. Submit 2 passport-sized photographs (only for people over 65 years of age).
  5. Pay the respective fees.

3.3.2 Expatriates

Expats must complete the following process to renew their Qatari ID:

  1. Download and properly fill out the application form from the official website of the MOI.
  2. Submit a copy of your current employer identification (Personal Sponsorships) or a copy of your current. employer establishment ID (Government entities, institutions, companies, and others).
  3. Then, submit the form and documents to the Expatriate Affairs Department.
